column2: [intro]
I'm here, tears in my eyes,
Nothing's right, I'm feeling so down,
Every day, I feel lost,
But I've learned a lesson, that's true,
There's no use in trying if you don't believe,
You need to find faith to advance step by step,
The path will be tough, but never too long,
If we put our whole heart in it, our dreams will grow strong.
People say I'm a fool,
Living in a world of crazies,
But I still believe in my ideas,
Because I know someday they’ll be realized.
There's no use in trying if you don't believe,
You need to find faith to advance step by step,
Critics will never be able to stop us,
For our determination will only grow more robust.
[solo]
